Docs.summary: Represents a snapshot of recorded drawing work ready to be inserted into a Graphite context.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
Produce a recording by calling <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecorder.Snap> on a recorder, insert it with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.InsertRecording(SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteRecording)>, and then submit the context's queued work with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKGraphiteContext.Submit>.
This type wraps a native Skia resource and implements `IDisposable`. Dispose it when done, either with a `using` statement or by calling `Dispose()` directly.
